data.name: Naeela
data.gender_notes: Naeela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Naeela is derived from the Arabic word ‘naeel’ meaning ‘gentle breeze’ or ‘soft wind’. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to a newborn girl as a symbol of the gentle, calming presence of Allah in her life. The name Naeela carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naeela usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle reminder of Allah's presence in our lives
data.etymology: Naeela belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naeela total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

As a young girl grows up, the name Naeela serves as a reminder of the comforting, ever-present love and care of Allah. Ultimately, the name Naeela reflects the idea that even in the midst of life's storms and challenges, Allah's gentle breeze of love and guidance can help us navigate the way to a peaceful and fulfilling existence.
